Visual only -- nothing about how the app works or what data it uses is changed. Turn this on before recording a screenshot or video you plan to share.

Debug builds only. Forces the next Source Evaluation run to end in a fixed, synthetic outcome instead of installing real extensions, so error and cancellation states can be tested deterministically. No real source, extension, or repository is contacted while a mode other than Off is selected.

Debug builds only. Forces the next Browse source listing to end in a fixed, synthetic failure instead of querying a real source, independent of the Source Evaluation debug fixture above. No real source, extension, or repository is contacted while a mode other than Off is selected.

Debug builds only. Adds one already-catalogued, not-installed extension to the Sources To Try surface so the real install and rollback path can be exercised. It does not invent a package or contact a new source.
